context: This criteria evaluates correct implementation of the product normalization utility from @vercel/commerce-commercejs. It assesses accurate transformation of raw Commerce.js product fields into the normalized @vercel/commerce format, including slug/path construction, image mapping, and variant group to options mapping.

checklist.name: Slug normalization
checklist.description: The normalized product's slug field is derived from the raw product's permalink field

checklist.name: Path construction
checklist.description: The normalized product's path field is constructed as '/' + permalink (e.g., '/my-product')

checklist.name: Image mapping
checklist.description: Each image in the raw product is mapped to an object with url (from image.url) and alt (from image.description or empty string) fields

checklist.name: Variant group to options mapping
checklist.description: The raw product's variant_groups array is mapped to the options array with displayName and values fields; variant values are extracted correctly

checklist.name: Variants normalization
checklist.description: Each variant is normalized with its id, sku, and options array, where options reference the corresponding variant group and selected values
